# FluidFTokenArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/FluidFTokenArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ERC4626Ark](./erc4626-ark.md)

**Title:**
FluidFTokenArk

Ark contract for managing token supply and yield generation through Fluid fTokens.

Implements strategy for depositing tokens, withdrawing tokens, and tracking yield from Fluid fToken vaults.

implements harvest function to claim rewards from Fluid's Merkle distributor


## Functions
### constructor

Constructor to set up the ERC4626Ark


```solidity
constructor(address _vault, ArkParams memory _params) ERC4626Ark(_vault, _params);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_vault`|`address`|Address of the ERC4626-compliant vault|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|ArkParams struct containing necessary parameters for Ark initialization|


### _harvest

Internal function for harvesting rewards from Fluid's Merkle distributor

Decodes merkle claim data, validates inputs, claims rewards, and forwards to Raft


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata data)
    internal
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`data`|`bytes`|ABI-encoded ClaimData|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardTokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the harvested reward tokens|
|`rewardAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The amounts of the harvested reward tokens|


## Errors
### InvalidMerkleClaimer
Thrown when the provided merkle claimer address is zero


```solidity
error InvalidMerkleClaimer();
```

### InvalidRecipient
Thrown when the provided recipient is not this Ark (prevents siphoning)


```solidity
error InvalidRecipient(address expected, address actual);
```

### InvalidRewardToken
Thrown when the reward token returned by the distributor is zero


```solidity
error InvalidRewardToken();
```

## Structs
### ClaimData
Encapsulates inputs to IFluidMerkleDistributor.claim


```solidity
struct ClaimData {
    /// @notice Address of the Fluid Merkle distributor contract to call
    address merkleClaimer;
    /// @notice Address of the recipient
    address recipient;
    /// @notice Cumulative amount of rewards to claim
    uint256 cumulativeAmount;
    /// @notice Type of position (1 = lending, 2 = vaults, 3 = smart lending, etc.)
    uint8 positionType;
    /// @notice ID of the position (fToken address for lending; vaultId for vaults)
    bytes32 positionId;
    /// @notice Cycle of the rewards
    uint256 cycle;
    /// @notice Merkle proof of the rewards
    bytes32[] merkleProof;
    /// @notice Arbitrary metadata forwarded to the distributor
    bytes metadata;
}
```
